acceptance_checks: No continuation entry-ready state can appear before higher-timeframe bias and expansion context are both active.
No anchor with a score below the configured minimum can arm the continuation workflow or outrank a higher-scoring competing anchor.
No anchor zone may trigger entry-ready status on its own without a continuation reaction and, when enabled, a protected-swing confirmation.
When correct-half respect is enabled, any close through the wrong side of equilibrium must downgrade or cancel the continuation path before entry-ready.
A deep pullback classification may stay visible as context, but it must block aggressive continuation entry-ready status until structure improves.
Once the active first target is already complete under the selected objective-completion mode, no fresh continuation entry-ready state may appear until a new higher-timeframe objective is defined.
Aggressive body-based invalidation must remain a preview overlay and cannot replace the stored protected-swing invalidation anchor.
When the one-more-candle filter is enabled, entry-ready status must wait for a follow-through bar after the first structural confirmation.
The script must remain bar-close confirmed, avoid intrabar-only state transitions, and stay within the configured request-security budget.
Backtest results must include spread, slippage, commission, and fee assumptions before performance is treated as credible.
Historical execution must assume next-bar-open entry after a confirmed bar-close signal instead of intrabar lookahead fills.
If stop and target touch in the same bar, assume the stop prints first unless lower-timeframe replay evidence proves the target filled first.

provisional_proxies.logic: Create candidate continuation anchors from equilibrium hold zones, fair value gaps, order blocks, breaker blocks, and post-consolidation resolution zones. Score each anchor using the explicit ranking table: +3 for correct-half equilibrium respect, +2 for shallow-or-moderate retracement depth, +2 for sweep or breakout-retest evidence, +2 for CISD within the reaction-bar limit, and +1 for protected-swing confirmation without wrong-side equilibrium failure. Require a score of at least 4 to arm an anchor and 6 or more to prefer it over nearby alternatives.

Measure retracement depth as the pullback distance versus the prior expansion leg. Classify pullbacks as shallow at or below 0.50 of the prior leg, moderate up to 0.62, deep above 0.62 while the protected swing still survives, and invalid once the protected swing breaks or a close exceeds the wrong-side equilibrium tolerance band.

Bullish continuation confirmation fires on the first close above the highest body edge of the last bearish candle cluster inside the pullback; bearish continuation confirmation mirrors the rule below the lowest body edge of the last bullish cluster. Optional displacement mode also requires the confirming candle to exceed a recent body percentile threshold.

Treat the higher-timeframe objective as still open until the selected first target is completed by wick touch or close through according to objectiveCompletionMode. Reject the continuation if local rotation count exceeds the configured limit before that objective is reached, or immediately block fresh entries once the active first target has already been completed.

Treat equilibrium respect as intact while closes remain in the correct half of the active range or only probe the midpoint within a 5% tolerance band of the full wick range. Any close beyond that tolerance in the wrong direction cancels continuation quality until the correct half is reclaimed.

signal_pipeline.logic: Enable continuation logic only when the higher timeframe is still in a continuation framework, the expansion context is intact, and the intermediate plus execution frames do not fight that direction.
signal_pipeline.name: Bias and Alignment Gate

signal_pipeline.logic: Require prior expansion, then demand a controlled retracement or local consolidation-resolution context instead of chasing a move that is already extended or structurally late.
signal_pipeline.name: Expansion and Retracement Gate

signal_pipeline.logic: Rank equilibrium, order-block, breaker, fair-value-gap, and breakout-resolution anchors, then allow continuation only if the correct side of equilibrium and the selected point of interest are still respected.
signal_pipeline.name: Anchor Selection and Equilibrium Filter

signal_pipeline.logic: After the anchor reacts, require a bar-close continuation shift through the opposing candle series, optionally add candle-three-style closure assistance, and then require a newly protected swing before continuation is treated as structurally valid.
signal_pipeline.name: Reaction and Structure Confirmation

signal_pipeline.logic: Keep the protected swing as the default stop, allow tighter body invalidation only conditionally, and reject continuation candidates that degrade into local range rotation, deep pullback failure, or poor reward-to-risk.
signal_pipeline.name: Risk, Failure, and Rotation Filter

signal_pipeline.logic: Only show continuation entries while the higher-timeframe objective remains open, reduce expectations after repeated expansion, and invalidate the setup once structure turns back into range or the objective is already complete.
signal_pipeline.name: Target Open and Exhaustion Management

The pullback becomes too deep, the setup rotates back into consolidation, the protected swing fails, or the higher-timeframe objective is already complete.
